sourceKind: Fixed community decompiled STS1 Java source; not authenticated PC execution or native platform validation
observations: CardLibrary.getCurse selects HashMap traversal after filtering special curses; dungeon curseRaw has a different order and must not substitute for transform selection.

AbstractPlayer.useCard: c.use queues own effects, then new UseCardAction queues Power reactions; hand.triggerOnOtherCardPlayed subsequently adds each Pain LoseHP to TOP. Therefore Pain resolves before Enrage Strength, own effects and disposal.

GameActionManager increments cardsPlayedThisTurn only for ordinary successful card activations, including queued repeats and autoplay; end-turn dontTriggerOnUseCard curses do not count. Normality checks the entire current hand before each activation.

Doubt and Shame each add one Weak/Frail with explicit isSourceMonster=true. ApplyPowerAction Artifact gate consumes each charge independently. New Weak/Frail skips first round reduction; stacking an existing power does not reinitialize justApplied.
Decay uses DamageInfo(player,2,THORNS): fixed damage consumes Block, ignores Strength/Weak/Vulnerable, and cannot trigger normal attack Thorns.
Clumsy ExhaustSpecificCardAction targets the hand at end-player-turn; no extra effect beyond ethereal. Writhe is innate, not ethereal.
Parasite onRemoveFromMasterDeck calls decreaseMaxHealth(3); maxHealth minimum 1 and currentHealth clamps down only when above the new maximum. No HP-loss combat callbacks apply.
integration: Call abyss_curses.onRemove(owner,removedInstance) once for each successful permanent remove or transform transaction; owner has hp and maxHp, instance has cardId. Return is actual maxHp loss, 0 for other cards. Do not call for combat discard or exhaust.

Run/Nodes event acquisition and transform source-to-local mapping, generatedCards launch manifest and acquire/remove relic hooks are owned by integration; this slice adds real capability and combat implementations, not those routes.
remainingEvidence: The shared pre-existing ethereal implementation scans hand order. Original DiscardAtEndOfTurnAction shuffles the trigger list using unseeded Collections.shuffle; exact multi-ethereal exhaustion ordering remains an explicit shared engine difference.
No whole-suite check, candidate compile/export, official import or native gameplay run in this worktree.
